title: Ruinous
subtitle: Mortem — death, decay, withering
text: Ruinous blood is Mortem in the old vocabulary: rot, entropy, and the inevitable end. It thrives on decay and lingering harm. Blood aged in Mortem has passed through so much death that death has become its natural language. It does not destroy quickly. It dissolves slowly, thoroughly, and completely. The Ruinous enzyme marks this tendency without softening what it is.
